# Command reference

Usage: `skigard COMMAND [ARGS]`. Flags may come before or after positional arguments, and both `-flag` and `--flag` work. Every command and subcommand accepts `-h` or `--help`, which prints its usage to stdout and exits 0 without reading or changing your home.

## Flags every command takes

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--home PATH` | skigard home directory (default `$SKIGARD_HOME`, `~/.config/skigard`, or `%APPDATA%\skigard` on Windows) |
| `--json` | machine-readable output |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | success |
| `1` | policy, drift or findings (for example `verify` found drift, a scan blocked) |
| `2` | usage error or failure |
| `3` | cancelled |
| `4` | scan coverage incomplete |

## Commands

- [`init`](#skigard-init): create the skigard home directory
- [`detect`](#skigard-detect): list agent harnesses found on this machine
- [`add`](#skigard-add): fetch, scan, score and (per mode) install a skill; --quarantine-only stops after the scan
- [`scan`](#skigard-scan): scan a skill
- [`review`](#skigard-review): have an agent harness review a quarantined skill (advisory)
- [`diff`](#skigard-diff): show quarantined changes against the approved version
- [`approve`](#skigard-approve): HUMAN ONLY: approve a quarantined skill
- [`reject`](#skigard-reject): delete a quarantined skill
- [`update`](#skigard-update): re-fetch approved skills; changes go to quarantine
- [`install`](#skigard-install): install approved skills into harnesses
- [`uninstall`](#skigard-uninstall): remove skills installed by skigard
- [`sync`](#skigard-sync): install every approved skill into the default harnesses
- [`config`](#skigard-config): read or change mode, threshold, auto_review, review_harness and marketplace (set of mode/threshold is human only)
- [`verify`](#skigard-verify): check lock, store, installs and marketplace if built (CI-friendly)
- [`lock`](#skigard-lock): upgrade lock entries to hash version 2 (only if the old hash still matches)
- [`init-ci`](#skigard-init-ci): write a GitHub workflow that runs skigard verify
- [`list`](#skigard-list): list approved and quarantined skills
- [`show`](#skigard-show): print a skill's SKILL.md and file list
- [`status`](#skigard-status): summary of this home
- [`doctor`](#skigard-doctor): check the environment
- [`stats`](#skigard-stats): estimate the context cost of approved skills
- [`allow`](#skigard-allow): HUMAN ONLY: stop reporting medium/low scanner rules for one source
- [`plugin`](#skigard-plugin): manage plugins (groups of approved skills)
- [`marketplace`](#skigard-marketplace): optional: build or check a Claude/OMP marketplace for publishing plugins
- [`harness`](#skigard-harness): inspect or extend the harness registry
- [`rules`](#skigard-rules): list scanner rules
- [`migrate`](#skigard-migrate): import approved skills from an skm repository
- [`completion`](#skigard-completion): print a shell completion script
- [`version`](#skigard-version): print the version

## skigard init

Create the skigard home directory.

```
skigard init [--git]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--git` | also run git init in the home |

## skigard detect

List agent harnesses found on this machine.

```
skigard detect [--all]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--all` | include harnesses that were not found |

## skigard add

Fetch, scan, score and (per mode) install a skill; --quarantine-only stops after the scan.

```
skigard add SOURCE [--skill N | --all] [--mode strict|auto] [--threshold N] [--review] [--force-install] [--quarantine-only]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--all` | take every skill found |
| `--copy` | copy instead of symlink |
| `--force` | allow replacing a name that is already approved |
| `--force-install` | install whatever the score, recorded as forced (human terminal only, refused inside an agent) |
| `--include-unverified` | also install to harnesses whose paths are not verified |
| `--mode STRING` | strict or auto (default: your setting; inside an agent only a stricter one than the setting is allowed) |
| `--name STRING` | store the skill under this name |
| `--project STRING` | project root for --scope project (default: current directory) |
| `--quarantine-only` | only fetch and scan; leave the skill in quarantine |
| `--review` | run an advisory review before scoring (sends the skill to a model provider) |
| `--review-harness STRING` | harness that runs the review (default: your saved choice) |
| `--scope STRING` | user or project (default "user") |
| `--skill STRING` | take one skill by name or path |
| `--threshold INT` | minimum safety score 1..10 for auto install (default: your setting; inside an agent it cannot be lower) |
| `--to STRING` | comma-separated harness ids (default: detected, verified harnesses) |

## skigard scan

Scan a skill.

```
skigard scan NAME|PATH [--format text|json|sarif]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--fail-on STRING` | exit 1 at this severity or above: low, medium, high, critical, none (default "high") |
| `--fail-on-incomplete` | exit 4 when scan coverage is incomplete |
| `--format STRING` | text, json or sarif (default "text") |
| `--output STRING` | write the report to a file |
| `--plain` | text format: no colours and no grouping (the default when not on a terminal) |

## skigard review

Have an agent harness review a quarantined skill (advisory).

```
skigard review NAME [--harness ID | --manual]
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `record NAME --verdict V --summary S` | record a manual review (advisory) |

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--allow-policy-only` | if no OS sandbox works here, run a verified reviewer isolated by policy only (advisory review; has no effect on approval) |
| `--allow-unverified` | allow reviewer templates that have not been verified |
| `--harness STRING` | harness to run as the reviewer (default: your saved choice, or you pick) |
| `--list` | list harnesses that can review, then exit |
| `--manual` | print the review prompt instead of running a harness |
| `--model STRING` | model for the reviewer, if it supports --model |

## skigard diff

Show quarantined changes against the approved version.

```
skigard diff NAME
```

## skigard approve

HUMAN ONLY: approve a quarantined skill.

```
skigard approve NAME
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--accept STRING` | accept all current low/medium findings, with this reason |
| `--accept-expires STRING` | expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD) for --accept |
| `--override` | approve despite a BLOCK verdict, incomplete coverage or a FAIL review |
| `--reason STRING` | why the override is acceptable (required with --override) |

## skigard reject

Delete a quarantined skill.

```
skigard reject NAME
```

## skigard update

Re-fetch approved skills; changes go to quarantine.

```
skigard update [NAME...]
```

## skigard install

Install approved skills into harnesses.

```
skigard install NAME... | --plugin P
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--copy` | copy instead of symlink |
| `--force` | replace an existing unmanaged skill (the old one is kept as a backup) |
| `--include-unverified` | also install to harnesses whose paths are not verified |
| `--plugin STRING` | install every skill in this plugin |
| `--project STRING` | project root for --scope project (default: current directory) |
| `--scope STRING` | user or project (default "user") |
| `--to STRING` | comma-separated harness ids (default: detected, verified harnesses) |

## skigard uninstall

Remove skills installed by skigard.

```
skigard uninstall [NAME...]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--force` | remove even if the install was modified |

## skigard sync

Install every approved skill into the default harnesses.

```
skigard sync
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--copy` | copy instead of symlink |
| `--force` | replace an existing unmanaged skill (the old one is kept as a backup) |
| `--include-unverified` | also install to harnesses whose paths are not verified |
| `--project STRING` | project root for --scope project (default: current directory) |
| `--scope STRING` | user or project (default "user") |
| `--to STRING` | comma-separated harness ids (default: detected, verified harnesses) |

## skigard config

Read or change mode, threshold, auto_review, review_harness and marketplace (set of mode/threshold is human only).

```
skigard config get [KEY] | set KEY VALUE
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `get [KEY]` | print one setting, or all of them (keys: mode, threshold, auto_review, review_harness, marketplace) |
| `set KEY VALUE` | change a setting (mode and threshold: human terminal only) |

## skigard verify

Check lock, store, installs and marketplace if built (CI-friendly).

```
skigard verify [--strict] [--require-human]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--require-human` | fail if any approval was made automatically (mode auto) or forced |
| `--strict` | treat warnings (overrides, non-pass reviews) as failures |

## skigard lock

Upgrade lock entries to hash version 2 (only if the old hash still matches).

```
skigard lock upgrade [NAME...]
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `upgrade [NAME...]` | upgrade lock entries to hash version 2 (only if the old hash still matches) |

## skigard init-ci

Write a GitHub workflow that runs skigard verify.

```
skigard init-ci [--version X.Y.Z] [--action-sha SHA]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--action-sha STRING` | full commit SHA of ambierhq/skigard-action to pin (default: a placeholder you must fill in) |
| `--force` | overwrite an existing .github/workflows/skigard.yml |
| `--version STRING` | skigard version to pin in the workflow (default: this binary's version) |

## skigard list

List approved and quarantined skills.

```
skigard list
```

## skigard show

Print a skill's SKILL.md and file list.

```
skigard show NAME
```

|---|---|

Estimate the context cost of approved skills.


|---|---|

## skigard allow

HUMAN ONLY: stop reporting medium/low scanner rules for one source.

```
skigard allow add SOURCE|SKILL RULE... --reason R | list | remove SOURCE [RULE...]
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `add SOURCE|SKILL RULE... --reason R` | HUMAN ONLY: stop reporting medium/low rules for one source |
| `list` | list allowed rules |
| `remove SOURCE [RULE...]` | HUMAN ONLY: remove allowed rules |

## skigard plugin

Manage plugins (groups of approved skills).

```
skigard plugin create|delete|add|remove|show|list
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `create NAME [--description D]` | create an empty plugin |
| `delete NAME` | delete a plugin |
| `add NAME SKILL...` | add approved skills to a plugin |
| `remove NAME SKILL...` | remove skills from a plugin |
| `show NAME` | show a plugin's skills |
| `list` | list plugins |

## skigard marketplace

Optional: build or check a Claude/OMP marketplace for publishing plugins.

```
skigard marketplace build|check
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `build` | write the marketplace/ directory |
| `check` | report drift between marketplace/ and the approved skills |

## skigard harness

Inspect or extend the harness registry.

```
skigard harness list|add
```

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `list` | list known harnesses and whether they were detected |
| `add --id ID [--name N] [--global DIR] [--project DIR] [--bin B]` | add a harness to skigard.toml |

## skigard rules

List scanner rules.

```
skigard rules
```

## skigard migrate

Import approved skills from an skm repository.

```
skigard migrate --from-skm PATH
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from-skm STRING` | path to an skm repository |
